name: Kansas Flavor
old_description: Our products are available throughout the state of Kansas. All of our products are home made, and pack amazing flavor. Have a look at some recipes for each of our products, and find your local Kansas retailer!
about:
Kansas Flavor operates from Valley Center, Kansas, producing a line of homemade specialty food products distributed to retailers across the state. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The product lineup includes seven items: Bread & Butter Jalapenos, Garlic Ranch Marinade, Jalapeno Mustard, Rub It Raw seasoning blend, Seasoning Salt, Cajun Marinade, and Cajun Seasoning. All products are described as homemade, though the company does not specify facility size, headcount, production volumes, or specific manufacturing processes.

Kansas Flavor sells through a network of more than 25 retail locations spanning the state, including specialty meat markets such as Krehbiels Specialty Meats in McPherson and Yoder Meats in Yoder; barbecue and spice retailers like All Things BBQ and Spice Merchant in Wichita; antique and vintage shops that carry food items such as Paramount Marketplace in Wichita and Fannie Sterling 1884 in Peabody; and grocery and liquor stores including ABC Discount Wine & Spirit in Wichita and Missie's Discount Liquors in Shawnee.

The company states that its products are homemade and "pack amazing flavor," positioning its artisanal preparation as a point of difference, though no further details on formulation philosophy or quality standards are provided.
